items.title: APH Q3 deep dive: AI demand and acquisitions drive exceptional growth and outlook
items.summary: Electrical connector manufacturer Amphenol (NYSE:APH) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 65.1% year on year to $10.23 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($10.4 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 6.1% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.80 per share was 9.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
